pages.title: Vegetables
pages.text: Vegetables are hearty, grounding foods. $(#e05252)Penalty:$() reduced movement speed when depleted. $(#52c252)Bonus:$() improved hunger saturation when maintained. Carrots, potatoes, and beetroot all qualify.

pages.title: Vegetables — Farm & Charm
pages.text: Farm & Charm adds tomatoes, onions, peppers, and more. Growing these alongside vanilla crops gives excellent variety within the Vegetables group and makes maintaining it effortless.

pages.title: Vegetables — Vanilla
pages.text: Without Farm & Charm, beetroot is your best secondary vegetable alongside carrots and potatoes. A small mixed crop farm covers this group reliably from early game onward.
